title: Apache DataSketches
subtitle: Approximate answers from compact aggregate state.
intro: Build sketches over rows, persist their typed state, and query estimates later. Select a family for distinct counts, quantiles or frequent items; merge states to summarize partitions.

reference.name: datasketch_theta
reference.description: Distinct-count sketch with union, intersection and difference.

reference.name: datasketch_quantiles / datasketch_req
reference.description: Alternative quantile families with different error behavior.

reference.name: datasketch_tdigest
reference.description: Compact distribution summary for quantile estimates.

reference.name: datasketch_frequent_items
reference.description: Track frequent strings or numbers and their estimated counts.

reference.name: datasketch_hll_union(lg_k, sketch)
reference.description: Aggregate compatible HLL states before estimating the union.

notes.title: Merge states, not estimates
notes.body: Adding daily distinct estimates double-counts people present on multiple days. Merge compatible sketches first, then ask for the final estimate.

notes.title: Match accuracy to the workload
notes.body: lg_k controls HLL size; k controls KLL capacity. Larger settings use more memory. Quantile rank error is not an absolute error bound on the returned value.

examples.title: Count distinct values
examples.caption: An approximate count of 1,000 distinct values from 10,000 input rows.

examples.title: Estimate p50 and p95
examples.sql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT datasketch_kll(200, i::DOUBLE) AS s
  FROM range(10000) AS t(i)
)
SELECT datasketch_kll_quantile(s, 0.50, true)
         AS p50,
       datasketch_kll_quantile(s, 0.95, true)
         AS p95
FROM agg;
examples.caption: The trailing true requests inclusive search. Input type determines sketch type.

examples.title: Inspect retained state
examples.caption: The sketch tracks the number of input items, independently of its retained sample.

assertions: SELECT CASE WHEN datasketch_kll_n(datasketch_kll(200,i::DOUBLE))=10000 THEN true ELSE error('sketch count') END FROM range(10000)t(i);
